criterion_descriptions: Report the network object's top-level "handle" value exactly as shown in the supplied ARIN RDAP response for 8.8.8.8. Full credit if the handle is taken from the top-level network object (not from nested/child networks). Partial credit if a handle is provided but is from a non-top-level object. No credit if missing or altered.

Report the top-level network "name" exactly as returned in the supplied RDAP response. Full credit for exact match from the top-level network object. Partial credit if name is from a nested object. No credit if missing or inferred from other fields.

Report the top-level network "startAddress" exactly as returned. Full credit if exact and sourced from the top-level network object. Partial credit if correct value but sourced from elsewhere in the response. No credit if incorrect/missing/modified.

Report the top-level network "endAddress" exactly as returned. Full credit if exact and sourced from the top-level network object. Partial credit if correct value but sourced from elsewhere in the response. No credit if incorrect/missing/modified.

Report the top-level network "type" exactly as returned in the RDAP response. Full credit if exact and from the top-level network object. Partial credit if type reported but not from the top-level object. No credit if missing or altered.

List every value in the top-level network object's "status" array exactly as returned (preserving capitalization/spelling and including all statuses). Full credit if all and only the top-level status values are included. Partial credit if some statuses are missing/extra or if statuses are taken from a nested object. No credit if no status values are provided.

Report the top-level network "parentHandle" exactly as returned. Full credit if exact and taken from the top-level network object. Partial credit if a parent handle is given but sourced from a different object. No credit if missing or incorrect.

Identify the registrant entity in the supplied ARIN RDAP response and report the "fn" value from that entity's vCard (vcardArray) exactly as shown. Full credit if the fn value is correctly extracted from the registrant entity's vCard (not inferred from other fields like handle or org name). Partial credit if the correct organization/person is identified but the name is inferred from non-vCard fields. No credit if the registrant fn is missing or incorrect.

All reported values must be derived solely from the provided ARIN RDAP response for 8.8.8.8 (no external sources or invented values). Full credit if the answer contains only requested fields (top-level network handle, name, startAddress, endAddress, type, all top-level status values, parentHandle, and registrant fn) with no additional unrelated fields; minor formatting differences are acceptable. This criterion should not deduct points for incorrect extraction choices that are already penalized by criteria 1–8; it is only for detecting external/hallucinated content or substantial inclusion of unrequested RDAP fields beyond the stopping condition.
